children.text: Note: The following block/prefer lists are just examples, it’s always more efficient to make your own.
⬥ It's assumed the player will slay Moss Golems for Creatures of the Lost Grove tasks and Ripper Demons for Demon cluster tasks, as well as bringing Binding Contracts
⬥ These lists are made for use with Laniakea

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Before level 90, when you can't use her as your Slayer Master, its generally not worth thinking too hard about your block/prefer list, and you can just block tasks you don't like or find unrewarding.

⬥ Click File > Make a copy top left for a personal copy.
⬥ Toggle the Home page settings to match what you use.
    • The Misc section is for unlisted XP modifiers, e.g. enter 10 if you have an unlisted 10% XP buff.
⬥ Enter your KPH in the column on the right of the Experience page.
    • You can select tasks to lock, force prefer/block, and that you use

for here as well.
⬥ Select the focus of your Slaying in the next page's dropdown menu and copy the displayed Block and Prefer list.
⬥ Players start with a only a few slots to block/prefer monsters, gaining 1 of each every 50 Quest Points achieved, up to a maximum of 8 slots to block and prefer monsters at 400 Quest Points.
⬥ Don't be afraid to skip undesired or bad assignments, as you can skip around half of the tasks given by Laniakea
without losing many Slayer points overall, and they can be farmed with relative ease, making it unnecessary to force yourself to do any tasks you dislike.
⬥ The assignment given by your Slayer Master is
completely random, a system unique to each Slayer Master known as
is used to make some assignments more common than others, and may be a factor in what the player chooses to block/prefer.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The higher the weighting, the more common the assignment compared to others, the weighting for each task a Slayer Master has can be viewed on their page of the RuneScape Wiki.
